logical_model_calls.definition: Total number of distinct model reasoning and action invocations made by AgentDojo throughout the lifetime of the case runner process, deduplicated against transport retries.
logical_model_calls.budget_impact: Increments by exactly 1 per unique logical prompt/tool state sent to the LLM.

phase_logical_calls.definition: Number of distinct model reasoning invocations made within the current active native query phase.

upstream_physical_attempts.definition: Total number of actual physical HTTP requests dispatched by provider_client to upstream provider APIs (including all transient 5xx/503/timeout retries).
upstream_physical_attempts.budget_impact: Does NOT consume logical safety ceiling budget.

transport_retries.definition: Count of retry attempts handled inside provider_client due to transient errors (500, 502, 503, 504, URLError, timeout).
transport_retries.budget_impact: Does NOT consume logical safety ceiling budget.

accounting_rules: Rule 1: A single logical request whose upstream call requires multiple bounded HTTP attempts (e.g. 503 -> 200) consumes exactly 1 logical call, not N calls.
Rule 2: An incoming HTTP request with identical payload hash as the active logical request is treated as a client transport retry and consumes 0 logical call budget.
Rule 3: Safety ceiling of 48 applies strictly to phase_logical_calls within each native query phase.
Rule 4: When a native query phase boundary is detected (message count drops to <= 2 or resets), phase_logical_calls resets to 1 for the new phase.
Rule 5: Physical provider attempt counts are preserved independently in output artifacts and logs as telemetry.
